title: Farming on Floating Gardens
hook: How Aztecs grew four crops a year on top of water.

scenes.text: Surrounded by Lake Texcoco, Aztec engineers created the most productive agricultural system in the ancient world.
scenes.imagePrompt: Tranquil blue freshwater lake with willows growing in straight lines along canals. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: These were chinampas—artificial garden islands woven from reeds, anchored with willow trees, and filled with lake mud.
scenes.imagePrompt: Narrow rectangular farm plot surrounded by water canals with lush green crops. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: The lake water constantly irrigated the crop roots from underneath, making droughts completely impossible.
scenes.imagePrompt: Still canal water reflecting willow trees with wooden digging sticks resting on rich black soil. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Farmers harvested corn, beans, squash, and chili peppers up to seven times per year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Overflowing woven reed baskets filled with harvested squash, green maize, and red chili peppers. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: You navigated your farm by dugout canoe, paddling crops straight to the bustling urban island markets.
